entry.title: SoFi stock digest, 2026-11-18
entry.content:
The stock fell to $14.28 on 17 November, and the chats were about little else. The one new discussion post asks whether CEO Anthony Noto's "buying all year" is a signal. His Form 4 record shows five open-market purchases in 2026, the last on 16 June, so "keeps buying" overstates it. The three Form 4s filed on 17 November are routine vesting of restricted stock units (RSUs), not trades. No story qualified for Must know: no results, guidance or company announcements came out in the window, and the one filing is routine.

entry.title: SoFi stock digest, 2026-11-15
entry.content:

The one piece of news is SoFiUSD going live on the Polygon blockchain on 12 November. A member posted the headline in that day's chat and nobody replied. Polygon Labs announced it, and no SoFi release was found. No story qualified for Must know: there are no results, filings or company announcements in the window, and the Polygon launch drew no attention on the sub.

entry.title: SoFi stock digest, 2026-11-12
entry.content:
Another quiet run, with no filings or SoFi announcements since the 10-Q on 5 November. The sub's two new posts are ARK buying the stock on 9 November and a crypto-press piece on SoFiUSD running on the Monad blockchain, which turns out to describe an August expansion. The chats for 10 to 12 November are about talk of a larger rate hike and a stock that, in members' words, "reacts to everything but its own news". No story qualified for Must know: there are no results, filings or company announcements in the window, and the ARK purchase is a fund's trade, not a company event.

entry.title: SoFi stock digest, 2026-11-06
entry.content:

The one material event is the Q3 10-Q, filed on 5 November, which no thread mentioned. It answers the question the last two entries left open: how the 2026 convertible notes were settled.

Two valuation posts applied the new 2027 guide in opposite directions, and nothing was filed or announced. entry.title: SoFi stock digest, 2026-10-29
entry.content:
The 27 October print landed and the sub's mood flipped. Before the release the chats expected "a triple beat followed by the stock pumping"; this time there was no fade, and the chats have gone from capitulation to rocket emojis. SoFi beat, raised its 2026 revenue guide and gave a first 2027 outlook. At least nine sell-side firms moved their targets afterwards, all upward. The only filing in the window is the 8-K carrying the release. It says nothing about how the convertible notes that matured on 15 October were settled.

entry.title: SoFi stock digest, 2026-10-26

The eve-of-earnings run. Nothing new was filed or announced in the three days since the last entry, so no story qualified for Must know; the 27 October results were Must know on 8 October and their date has not moved. The only new organic post is a long-term-holding pep talk. The chats are pre-print positioning, plus one piece of speculation about convertible notes that matured eleven days ago. One new sell-side initiation appeared in the headlines but not on the sub.

entry.title: SoFi stock digest, 2026-10-23
entry.content:
Four days from the 27 October print, the sub got company news instead of price action for the first time in a fortnight: a tokenized deposit product on 22 October and a life-insurance partnership on 21 October, both confirmed outside Reddit. The filing drought also ended — a Form 4 on 22 October is SoFi's first filing since 23 September — and a third sell-side target cut landed on the morning of this run. The daily chats themselves have not changed: a countdown comment, a short-interest argument, and members watching whether the stock can hold $15.

entry.title: SoFi stock digest, 2026-10-20
entry.content:
A week out from the 27 October print, the sub has stopped arguing about the company and is just watching the price. No SEC filing since 23 September and no company release since the 8 October Orbi deal, so no story qualified for Must know — the 27 October results and the guidance behind them were already Must know on 8 October and nothing about them has changed. What is new: the stock set a fresh 52-week low, a published consensus figure now sits under the sub's 17-cent estimate, and the tone in the daily chats has turned from impatience to capitulation. The one unanswered question a member raised — why SoFi Tech Solutions is listing events — has an answer the thread never got.

entry.title: SoFi stock digest, 2026-10-14
entry.content:
Two sell-side notes landed in the three days since the last run and took opposite sides on the same quarter, which gave the sub something concrete to argue about for the first time in a fortnight. The macro backdrop got worse while they did: the 14 October daily chat opens on a hot CPI print, mixed bank results and members watching Bank of America fall pre-market. The run's other organic content is an AI-generated bear case the sub rejected on its comps, and the usual pre-earnings options talk.

entry.title: SoFi stock digest, 2026-10-08
entry.content:
The sub is waiting on Q3 results, due 27 October, and is frustrated that the stock keeps falling while the wider market rises. Most of the explanation offered is interest rates. Hot is mostly valuation charts from one prolific poster and daily-chat threads. The new company news is a crypto-linked card deal in Mexico, and the best thread is an institutional holder's emailed answer about what the market is not pricing in.
